find_files.description: Find visible files below required repository-relative directory path (empty string for root). A pattern without /, such as *.py, recursively matches basenames; a pattern with / is relative to path and requires a complete ** segment for recursion. **.py is invalid. Results are bounded and unpaged; when partial, narrow path or pattern.

grep.description: Search visible UTF-8 text with required pattern, mode=literal|regex, repository-relative path, and file_pattern. Prefer literal for symbols and strings. A slashless *.py recursively matches basenames; **.py is invalid. When partial, narrow pattern, path, or file_pattern.

read_file.description: Read a visible file using required path, version=current|base|head, and optional start_line/end_line (integers >=1). Omit both for a bounded whole-file read. Example: start_line=10, end_line=20. When partial, reuse the start_line and end_line values from the returned next_line_range.

get_diff.description: Read complete verified base-to-current diff hunks below required path. Omit cursor on the first call; reuse next_cursor with the same path while status=partial. Oversized hunks require the suggested read_file ranges and do not count as reviewed.

comment.description: Submit a bounded finding batch. side=old targets removed lines and side=new added lines. existing_code must quote the smallest exact consecutive changed lines, without diff markers or unchanged context. Items resolve independently; retry only rejected_comments indices.

retract_comment.description: Retract current-run candidate_ids when later evidence disproves a submitted Comment. Supply a non-empty reason. Saying retracted in task_done or final text does not change Candidate state.

task_done.description: Finish with a short summary only after host-derived evidence coverage reaches the initial review_file_count; do not call this tool to probe completion. A missing_review_files result includes host-derived reviewed, missing, and total counts; inspect every listed file before retrying. After the retry limit, completion may succeed with incomplete_files.

finalize_plan.description: Submit and finalize one complete selection: General alone or at least two specialists, never mixed. Every reference must be eligible and available. Call exactly once.

verdict.description: Accept or deny cluster_ids. Accept publishes canonical fields. Deny suppresses a contradicted, nonactionable, duplicate, or evidence-incomplete claim whose defect cannot be established; weak/inferred alone is insufficient.

merge.description: Merge only same-root-cause cluster_ids into one Finding. All Comment fields and an exact changed source excerpt are required and become final; each claim, dimension, location, evidence strength, and severity must remain evidence-backed.

finalize_verdicts.description: Finalize after every cluster is covered exactly once by accept, deny, or merge. Unknown, repeated, or uncovered clusters are rejected.

deduplicate.description: Submit batch accept/deny decisions for survived findings by verdict_decision_id. Deny a finding only when it clearly duplicates an existing finding — same issue at the same or shifted location.

deduplicate_done.description: Declare every survived finding has been decided. Call only after deduplicate covers all findings exactly once.
